scope: Three-robot main scenes: L3 9, C3 9, K3 6, X3 3 (control), D3 3 (control). Analytic only: no simulation, LLM or paid call was run.

knowledge_contract.knows_references: Order IDs only (complete order: colour, count, sign). A robot does not learn that an order it lacks does not exist.
knowledge_contract.can_grasp: Optional {rid: [colours]}: the robot can only grasp those colours. A robot knows its own capability, not the others.
knowledge_contract.coordinates: Evaluator-only. Never give world coordinates, box IDs or oracle plans to the LLM.
knowledge_contract.one_carry: Each robot carries at most one box per run. Demand never exceeds the number of robots.
knowledge_contract.boxes: Always 3 boxes, 2 of one colour and 1 of the other (the largest pool the runner has used for a team scene).

model: model3.py = the time model, oracle and baselines U / S of scenes/check_scenes.py (reproduces its 3-robot estimates)
selection_rule: L3, C3, K3: oracle - baseline >= 0.5 correct boxes under BOTH U and S. X3, D3: equal-count controls (control=true): X3 baseline end - oracle completion >= 60 s, D3 >= 1 expected wrong-box move.
